output.summary: A shrubby annual, biennial or perennial native to the coasts of western Europe and the Mediterranean, tree mallow bears dark pink to purple flowers in clusters. It tolerates seawater and usually grows on exposed coasts and small islands. Its seeds are edible; some sources also describe the hairy leaves as edible but unpalatable unless finely cut.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are edible; some sources describe the leaves as edible but unpleasantly hairy unless cut very thinly.
